chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from 'Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I heard him say: 'Indeed, the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatiha) is sufficient by itself in the obligatory prayer.'

key_terms.فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ: The Opening of the Book, referring to Surah Al-Fatiha

ai.seo_question: Is it sufficient to recite only Surah Al-Fatiha in the obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), transmitted through the reliable chain of al-Tusi’s Tahdhib, clarifies that Surah Al-Fatiha alone satisfies the essential requirement of Qira'ah in the obligatory prayer. This ruling underscores the primacy of the 'Mother of the Book' as the core pillar of recitation, distinguishing it from the recommended (mustahabb) addition of other surahs. It reflects the Shia juristic view that while additional recitation is praiseworthy, it is not a condition for the validity of the prayer itself.
